title: periploca laevigata subsp. angustifolia
intro: Periploca laevigata subsp. angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaved blue swallowtail vine or slender periploca, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its potential in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Periploca laevigata subsp. angustifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, which help in reducing swelling, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
